benecke-selected-polish-tales.note: The Gutenberg text was keyed from the 1944 World's Classics reprint (its front matter: 'first published in 1921 and reprinted in 1928, 1942, and 1944'). It is the 1921 selection reprinted unaltered, so the text is the 1921 public-domain text, but the copy is not a pre-1931 printing: flagged in DIGEST-C for Adam's veto.
